reforms.description: The federal government announced R&D and technology promotion incentives in 1983 as part of a medium-term Special Recovery Program. These included enhancement of investment tax credits, establishment of Special Recovery Funds, and draft amendments to the Income Tax Act to stimulate private R&D activity.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Investment tax credits and R&D incentives reduce the cost of capital for private innovation, encouraging firms to increase R&D spending and modernization, which supports productivity growth.
reforms.status_evidence: Announced in federal budget and October 1983; draft amendments proposed but implementation status unclear.
reforms.importance_rationale: Significant policy initiative targeting private R&D through multiple instruments (tax credits, recovery funds, legislative amendments), but narrower in scope than a system-wide restructuring.
reforms.source_quote: Promotion of technology and RAD expenditure. ... incentives to boost private fixed investment (also costed at $2.4 billion) through enhancement of investment tax credits, introduction of share-purchase tax credit and establishment of Special Recovery Funds for investment and export financing.

reforms.description: Canada replaced seven previous industrial, regional and trade development schemes with a single Industrial and Regional Development Program (IRDP) to rationalize administration and enhance available benefits and geographic coverage. The program provides assistance for modernization, new product/process development, industrial restructuring, infrastructure establishment, and market research.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Consolidation of seven schemes into one program reduces administrative complexity and expands geographic coverage and available benefits, improving allocative efficiency and incentivizing private investment in modernization and new product/process development.
reforms.status_evidence: Text states program is implemented (replaced seven previous schemes), but specific implementation year not provided in source.
reforms.importance_rationale: Structural reform consolidating seven separate development schemes into a single program represents a system-wide rationalization of industrial and regional development policy.
reforms.source_quote: Seven previous industrial, regional and trade development schemes have now been replaced by a single Industrial and Regional Development Program, with a view to rationalising administration as well as enhancing available benefits and their geographic coverage.
